page.overview:
What is Ishkal?

Ishkal is the fourth planet orbiting Sigma Draconis. It is believed that the word Shai-Hulud was first taken by the Zensunni Wanderers off this planet .

In Dune 2000 Draconis IV is home to house Ordos.
